name: Zucchini

low.description: Safe serving with low FODMAP content

moderate.description: Becomes moderate in fructans at this size

high.description: High in fructans, likely to trigger symptoms

siboNotes: Zucchini requires careful portion control. While low FODMAP at smaller servings, it becomes high in fructans at 85g or more. Stick to half-cup portions during the elimination phase.
preparationTips: Makes excellent 'zoodles' as a pasta alternative
Can be spiralized or sliced thin for salads
